title: Reading Fluency Assessment for Children

engineFeatures.meaning: low-pass and noise added at training time

label: For "Reading Fluency Assessment for Children": Measure oral reading fluency (words correct per minute, accuracy) from child audio to identify struggling readers early. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Adult speech used for evaluation.
